senses.definition: ancient priestly city 1 S 22:19 cf. v 11 c. ה loc. נֹ֫בֶה (Ges§ 90, 2 ad fin.), 21:2; 22:9; 𝔊 Νομβα, Νομμα, Νοβα, etc.; perhaps = נְבוֹ (q.v.) Ezr 2:29 = Ne 7:33, Ezr 10:43, 𝔊 Ναβον, Ναβια, etc. Site dub.; on Jerome’s identif. with Nobe near Lydda cf. BuhlGeogr. 189; a Bēt Nūbā lies c. 13 m. WNW. from Jerus., c. 10 SE. from Lydda.
Is 10:32 just N. of Jerus., station in (ideal) Assyrian march; cf. Ne 11:32 (inhab. by Benjamites); perhaps = 1. —2 S 21:16 read גֹּב (q.v. p. 146 supr.)
